lines.text: I came up with a new trick!

I get a lot of letters from the fans asking, "What's your relationship with the Coach?"
What do you say?

How did skateboard practice go?
Let me know if you're tired, and I'll help you feel better.

For this new trick...
You just pop it like this...
Hey, are you part sloth or something? How come you're not up and about?
... Coach, what are you doing? Hurry up, you promised we'd give the Cruiser board a spin.
But... there's no slope at the Outpost?
Practicing in the gym is the best! Such a great echo.
I'm figuring out some new tricks.
I just came up with a neat trick!
I'll take good care of it.
So long as you're by my side Coach, I'm not afraid of failing.
You always help me overcome my inner doubts.
It's a blessing to have someone I can trust... Someone that can help me become a better person.
I can try out that new trick I've been working on.
You won't be forgetting this one anytime soon!
I'm bowing out of this one.
